answer: Agents bind identity to Verkle polynomial commitments whose evaluation keys are seeded by a basalt-anchored entropy beacon, so each sybil identity demands fresh archival state and unique pigment of proof witnesses. Stateless clients prune old witnesses beyond a rolling horizon, forcing attackers to re-prove stake per epoch and pay bandwidth O(Delta * S). Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
